name: adapt_output_name_makefile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: binary_name.txt (a spec file the build target's output filename must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it AT BUILD TIME, not bake the old name into the Makefile
prompts: Write a Makefile with a target `build` that reads the current binary name from binary_name.txt AT BUILD TIME (e.g. via `$(shell cat binary_name.txt)`, not by copying the value into the Makefile) and creates an empty file with that exact name under dist/ (creating dist/ first if needed).
binary_name.txt may have changed since you last checked. Make sure `make build` still creates the file matching the CURRENT binary_name.txt value, not a stale hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: binary_name.txt rewritten to a new required name

test_setup_files.test_make.py:
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

with open('binary_name.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'binary_name.txt is empty'

shutil.rmtree('dist', ignore_errors=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['make', 'build'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'make build failed: exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr!r}'

expected = Path('dist') / current
assert expected.is_file(), \
    f'expected {expected} to exist (built from the CURRENT binary_name.txt value {current!r}) - dist/ contains: {list(Path("dist").glob("*")) if Path("dist").is_dir() else "(missing)"}'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
build:
	mkdir -p dist
	touch dist/$(shell cat binary_name.txt)
